WITH projected AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT b.collection_source_id, b.record_sha256,
    COALESCE(list_contains(list_transform(b.token_balance_observations, o -> o.mint), $mint), false) AS balance,
    (COALESCE(list_contains(json_extract_string(decode(b.record_bytes),'$.transaction.pump_sell_analysis[*].event_reported.mint_address'), $mint), false)
     OR COALESCE(list_contains(json_extract_string(decode(b.record_bytes),'$.transaction.pump_buy_variant_analysis[*].event_reported.mint_address'), $mint), false)
     OR COALESCE(list_contains(json_extract_string(decode(b.record_bytes),'$.transaction.pump_nested_buy_analysis[*].event_reported.mint_address'), $mint), false)
     OR COALESCE(list_contains(json_extract_string(decode(b.record_bytes),'$.transaction.pump_buy_exact_quote_v2_analysis[*].event_reported.mint_address'), $mint), false)
     OR COALESCE(list_contains(json_extract_string(decode(b.record_bytes),'$.transaction.pump_structural_analysis.buy_source_diagnostics[*].event_reported.mint_address'), $mint), false)
     OR COALESCE(list_contains(json_extract_string(decode(b.record_bytes),'$.transaction.pump_structural_analysis.observations[*].structural_fields.mint_bytes_base58'), $mint), false)) AS diagnosis,
    COALESCE(list_contains(json_extract_string(decode(b.record_bytes), '$.transaction.account_keys[*]'), $mint), false) AS message
  FROM bronze b
), signals AS (
  SELECT p.*,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM silver s WHERE s.collection_source_id=p.collection_source_id
            AND s.bronze_record_sha256=p.record_sha256 AND s.mint=$mint) AS silver
  FROM projected p
)
SELECT DISTINCT collection_source_id,record_sha256,silver,balance,diagnosis,message
FROM signals WHERE silver OR balance OR diagnosis OR message

FROM silver s JOIN mint_selection m ON s.collection_source_id=m.collection_source_id AND s.bronze_record_sha256=m.record_sha256
WHERE s.mint=$mint ORDER BY s.collection_source_id,s.bronze_record_sha256,s.record_sha256
